title: 0.2.22 reconnect launch fix
summary: This update keeps the reconnect recovery flow and fixes the PowerShell launch script so encoded comments cannot swallow executable statements.
highlights: The offline banner still uses the local insta360-hw://reconnect protocol to relaunch the backend.
launch_tool_suite.ps1 now keeps PowerShell statements on their own lines and uses ASCII comments for the sensitive startup sections.
A regression test guards against function/if/process-start statements being accidentally commented out.
The installer and release zip are rebuilt from the fixed launch script.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
